message.content:
Benar, ukuran XS tidak tersedia.  
Apakah Anda sudah memiliki nama produk atau ID yang ingin Anda cek? Dengan informasi tersebut saya bisa membantu memeriksa ketersediaan ukuran lain atau memberi rekomendasi alternatif.
message.reasoning: The user says "Hallo, ukuran XS tidak ada ya?" which means "Hello, size XS is not available, right?" They are asking if XS size is not available. We need to respond in Indonesian. We can say "Benar, ukuran XS tidak tersedia." But we might want to ask if they want to check other sizes or if they want to place an order. The user didn't specify a product. We can ask them to provide product name or ID. So we should respond politely, confirm that XS is not available, ask for product details.
